publicSnapshot.selfHashPolicy: EXPORT-MANIFEST.json is excluded from its own embedded hashes to avoid circular hashing; verify its separate final hash locally. sourceSha256 values retain original provenance, not candidate hashes.
publicSnapshot.bytePolicy: Tracked root .gitattributes uses * -text to preserve approved raw bytes; no Git text/eol normalization or local info/attributes override is required.

incrementalSync.method: Three-way source merge; preserve existing public adaptations; no private history imported.
incrementalSync.sourceSha256Policy: Original files[].sourceSha256 and sourceCommit remain historical export provenance. Current imported source bytes are recorded below; publicSnapshot.sha256 hashes public files.
incrementalSync.validationScope: Existing source-only default verification, targeted cursor-only test, optional visual test compilation and Git file/hash checks; no private full regression or real-asset acceptance.
